==English==
The Woman Receives a Dog<br>

Sadness! The woman is not loved.<br>
Disinterest! The woman doesn't have a gravity for anything.<br>
No amusement! The woman doesn't laugh.<br>
No love! The woman doesn't love.<br>

Hope! The man goes to the woman from Kentucky.<br>
Appreciation! The man gives the dog to the woman.<br>
Complaint! The man goes to Kentucky from the woman.<br>

A little happiness! The dog loves the woman.<br>
A little interest! The woman has a gravity for the dog.<br>
Amusement! The woman laughs.<br>
Lots of love! The woman loves the dog.
